name: AI Marketing Skills Suite
description: A comprehensive AI-driven marketing capability delivering 120 distinct marketing skill modules that function as a plugin, portable staff, or an 8-bot team. It spans seven key marketing disciplines—narrative, SEO/GEO, social, email, paid media, influencer marketing, and product launch—and integrates 8 auditing gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) to evaluate and optimize marketing effectiveness and compliance on one contract.

inputs.name: marketing_goal
inputs.description: The primary marketing objective or campaign goal to be achieved.

inputs.name: audience_data
inputs.description: Information about the target audience including demographics, interests, and behaviors.

inputs.name: content_assets
inputs.description: Collection of marketing content such as text, images, videos, or URLs to be used or analyzed.

inputs.name: channel_parameters
inputs.description: Settings and preferences specific to marketing channels like social platforms, email lists, paid ad settings, or influencer criteria.

inputs.name: audit_criteria
inputs.description: List of auditing gates to apply for quality, compliance, and performance checks.

outputs.name: marketing_strategy
outputs.description: A tailored marketing plan covering seven disciplines including narrative structure, SEO, social engagement, email sequencing, paid media strategy, influencer collaboration, and launch planning.

outputs.name: audit_reports
outputs.description: Detailed evaluations per auditing gate with actionable recommendations for improving marketing content and execution.

outputs.name: performance_metrics
outputs.description: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as reach, engagement, ROAS (Return On Ad Spend), conversion rates, and sentiment analysis.

outputs.name: content_recommendations
outputs.description: Suggestions for optimizing marketing messages, targeting, or channel use based on analysis and audit results.

patterns: AI-powered auditing gates for content quality and compliance
steps: Define marketing goals and target audience parameters.
Input or generate marketing content assets tied to seven marketing disciplines.
Apply 120 marketing skills as modular AI agents to develop strategies for narrative, SEO/GEO, social, email, paid ads, influencer marketing, and launch.
Run content and strategy through 8 auditing gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) to validate quality, compliance, and effectiveness.
Generate audit reports with suggested improvements and content recommendations.
Analyze performance metrics and adjust marketing strategy iteratively.
Deliver a comprehensive marketing plan and execution framework on a contractual basis.
use_cases: Developing multi-channel marketing campaigns integrating AI-driven insights.
Scaling marketing operations with AI-powered modular skill bots working across disciplines.
Quality assurance and compliance auditing for marketing content.
Optimizing campaign performance via data-driven AI insights and audits.
Managing influencer marketing and paid ad strategies in a unified AI system.
Launching new products with a coordinated narrative and marketing team simulation.

prompt_templates.name: generate_strategy
prompt_templates.template: Create a marketing strategy targeting {audience_data} to achieve {marketing_goal} using all seven disciplines.

prompt_templates.name: audit_content
prompt_templates.template: Evaluate the following marketing content against the audit gates: {audit_criteria} and provide improvement suggestions.

prompt_templates.name: performance_report
prompt_templates.template: Generate a performance report analyzing metrics from the latest campaign focused on {marketing_goal}.

prompt_templates.name: optimize_channel
prompt_templates.template: Recommend optimizations for the {channel_parameters} channel based on recent campaign outcomes.
